pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with predominantly sharp edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank and mid-neck exhibit larger relative spatial area and more acute vertices compared to the smaller, more rounded patches appearing towards the lower ventral area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored pathways forming a continuous topological web. Junction nodes consist primarily of tri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the primary flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a continuous fringe with high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged contours clearly visible against the foliage background.
